description: This PHP source file defines the UserRoleManagerService class, which manages user role managers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve the class name and instance of the user role manager, and handles dependency injection and error handling related to user roles.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerService
classes.description: Service class for managing user role managers, including retrieval and instantiation based on configuration, with dependency injection and error handling.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of the user role manager from configuration.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Instantiates and returns the user role manager object, ensuring it is of the correct type, and sets the current user context.
